{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df_clean['status'] == 'refunded')
df_clean = df_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Compute average revenue per order by channel, stratified by customer_segment
# We must compute within each segment to avoid confounding
# Then compute overall channel average (unweighted across segments)

# Group by channel and customer_segment, compute mean revenue
grouped = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'], as_index=False)['revenue_float'].mean()

# Compute overall average revenue per order per channel (unweighted across segments)
channel_avg = grouped.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_float'].mean()

# Extract the average revenue for each channel
email_avg = channel_avg[channel_avg['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_float'].iloc[0]
paid_search_avg = channel_avg[channel_avg['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_float'].iloc[0]

# Difference in average revenue between channels
diff = paid_search_avg - email_avg

# Print results
print(f'Email channel average revenue: {email_avg:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search channel average revenue: {paid_search_avg:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (paid_search - email): {diff:.4f}')"}
